+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright (c) 2026 Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'certified'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: nios_fixed_address
+short_description: Manage Infoblox DHCP fixed addresses
+version_added: "2.17"
+description:
+  - Creates, updates, and removes IPv4 and IPv6 DHCP fixed addresses.
+requirements:
+  - infoblox-client
+extends_documentation_fragment: nios
+options:
+  name:
+    description: Fixed address name.
+    required: true
+  ipaddr:
+    description: IPv4 or IPv6 address assigned to the client.
+    required: true
+  mac:
+    description: Client hardware address.
+    required: true
+  network:
+    description: Network containing the fixed address.
+    required: true
+  network_view:
+    description: Network view associated with the fixed address.
+    default: default
+  options:
+    description: DHCP options to configure.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  extattrs:
+    description: Extensible attributes.
+    type: dict
+  comment:
+    description: Comment for the fixed address.
+  state:
+    description: Desired state.
+    default: present
+    choices: [present, absent]
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Add an IPv4 fixed address
+  nios_fixed_address:
+    name: printer
+    ipaddr: 192.0.2.10
+    mac: 00:11:22:33:44:55
+    network: 192.0.2.0/24
+    provider:
+      host: "{{ inventory_hostname }}"
+      username: admin
+      password: secret
+'''
+
+RETURN = ''' # '''
+
+import ipaddress
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api import NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS, NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS
+from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios.api import WapiModule
+
+
+def validate_ip_addr_type(ip, arg_spec, module):
+    """Choose the WAPI fixed address object and address field based on IP version."""
+    try:
+        parsed = ipaddress.ip_address(ip)
+    except ValueError:
+        module.fail_json(msg="ipaddr must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address")
+    address_field = 'ipv4addr' if parsed.version == 4 else 'ipv6addr'
+    object_type = NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS if parsed.version == 4 else NIOS_IPV6_FIXED_ADDRESS
+    arg_spec[address_field] = arg_spec.pop('ipaddr')
+    module.params[address_field] = module.params.pop('ipaddr')
+    return object_type, arg_spec, module
+
+
+def options(module):
+    """Sanitize DHCP options into the WAPI representation."""
+    result = []
+    for item in module.params.get('options') or []:
+        if item.get('name') is None and item.get('num') is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg="each DHCP option must specify at least one of 'name' or 'num'")
+        if item.get('value') is None:
+            module.fail_json(msg="each DHCP option must specify 'value'")
+        option = {key: value for key, value in item.items() if value is not None}
+        option.setdefault('use_option', True)
+        option.setdefault('vendor_class', 'DHCP')
+        result.append(option)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    option_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(), num=dict(type='int'), value=dict(required=True),
+        use_option=dict(type='bool', default=True), vendor_class=dict(default='DHCP'),
+    )
+    ib_spec = dict(
+        name=dict(required=True), ipaddr=dict(required=True, ib_req=True),
+        mac=dict(required=True, ib_req=True), network=dict(required=True, ib_req=True),
+        network_view=dict(default='default', ib_req=True),
+        options=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=option_spec, transform=options),
+        extattrs=dict(type='dict'), comment=dict(),
+    )
+    argument_spec = dict(provider=dict(required=True), state=dict(default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']))
+    argument_spec.update(ib_spec)
+    argument_spec.update(WapiModule.provider_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    object_type, ib_spec, module = validate_ip_addr_type(module.params['ipaddr'], ib_spec, module)
+    result = WapiModule(module).run(object_type, ib_spec)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
